tei:div.tei:p: 379) tshogs mchod shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ 380)

gang zhig gsang sngags kyi cho ga sogs dang ma 'brel bar tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya bar 'dod na/ tshogs kyi dngos po gang yod rnams bshams la chu gtsang 'thor nas/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ snang srid snod bcud bdag lus phung po khams// skye mched thams cad ye nas chos kyi dbyings// gsal stong zung 'jug rgyal ba zhi khro yi// dkyil 'khor chen por gdod nas lhun grub pa'i// thugs rje 'od zer ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros// tshogs kyi dngos po'i 'bag rtsogs dri ma kun// bsreg gtor sbyangs bkrus dag cing gtsang bar gyur// bdag nyid lha yi gnas gsum 'bru gsum las// 381) 'od zer 'phros pas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams// ngo bo zag med ye shes bdud rtsi la// rnam pa gang la gang 'dod longs spyod rdzas// 'jig rten khams kun yongs su gang bar gyur// om̐ ā hūm̐/ ༈ phyogs bcu nam mkhas gar khyab zhing kun nas// sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang*// yul lha gzhi bdag rigs drug sems can sogs// thams cad tshogs kyi mgron du gshegs nas kyang*// 'dod yon tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bdag cag dad ldan rnams la dbang cig 382)bskur// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen phob// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ ༈ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams thams cad kyi phud nam mkhar 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// mchod 'os kun la tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyang zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dkar phyogs gzhi bdag lha klu sde brgyad tshogs// snang zhing srid pa'i skye 'gro ma lus kyang*// tshogs mchod bzhes la rgyal khams bde ba dang*// bdag sogs ci bsam 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi/ tshogs gtor bshal chu bcas te gtsang sar phul zhing*/

om̐ ā hūm̐/ tshogs kyi lhag ma'i mgron rigs thams cad la// dgra gegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa sogs// rang rang ci 'dod longs spyod phul ba yis// mnyes shing phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzod// u tsit+ta ba lin+ta khā hi/ ༈ de nas 383) tshogs rnams dngos grub tu blang zhing*/ hoḥ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba la brten nas bdag sogs yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen chos dang mthun pa'i dge legs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bdag sogs mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yag dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang dam pa thob par gyur ba'i bkra shis dge legs kyi char chen po yongs su 'bab par gyur cig tshogs mchod mdor bsdus 'di ni/ rang gi sring mo chos nyid bzang mos bskul ngor bris pa dge/ 384)
